topArticle.description: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

topArticle.summary: 国民党率いる右派連立与党は、政権樹立に必要な過半数に届かなかった。

topArticle.title: A renovation was meant to improve these Hong Kong homes - it ended in a blaze that killed 168
topArticle.description: A year after one of Hong Kong's deadliest fires, families left behind are still waiting for justice.

topArticle.title: Thirteen dead as mine disaster highlights illegal hunt for gold
topArticle.description: Indonesian authorities say another 13 are missing in the illegal gold mine, which flooded on Monday.

topArticle.summary: インドネシア当局によると、月曜日に浸水した違法金鉱山でさらに13人が行方不明となっている。

topArticle.title: Two screenings of Pakistani TV show cancelled in India after backlash
topArticle.description: The show, Dar-e-Nijaat, has become a sensation in India but is now embroiled in a political row.

topArticle.summary: 「Dar-e-Nijaat」はインドで人気を博したが、政治的対立に巻き込まれた。

topArticle.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
topArticle.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.

topArticle.title: Services domestic regulation disciplines enter into force for Kazakhstan
topArticle.description: On 25 November, Kazakhstan notified WTO members that, following conclusion of its domestic approval procedures, the disciplines on services domestic regulation had taken legal effect and had been incorporated into Kazakhstan's schedule under the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS) as of 27 October 2026. These disciplines, which entered into force at the 13th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC13) in February 2024, have the potential to reduce global trade costs by USD 127 billion.
topArticle.titleJa: カザフスタン、サービス国内規制規律が発効
topArticle.summary: カザフスタンは、サービス国内規制規律が法的効力を持ち、2026年10月27日よりGATSに組み込まれたとWTOに通報。これにより、世界の貿易コストが大幅に削減される可能性がある。

topArticle.title: EU launches safeguard investigation into certain composite input materials
topArticle.description: On 23 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (23 November 2026), a safeguard investigation into imports of certain composite input materials.
topArticle.titleJa: EU、特定の複合中間材料に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 欧州連合は2026年11月23日、特定の複合中間材料の輸入に対しセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知。自国産業保護の動きが見られる。

topArticle.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
topArticle.description: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.
topArticle.titleJa: パナマが情報技術協定拡大への参加を要請
topArticle.summary: パナマは、知識ベースで革新的な経済への移行を目指し、情報技術協定拡大（ITA II）への参加をWTOに要請した。

topArticle.title: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
topArticle.description: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials. The activity will take place from 1 to 12 February 2027 at the headquarters of the WIPO and of the WTO in Geneva, Switzerland.
topArticle.titleJa: WIPO-WTO知的財産問題幹部研修プログラムの応募開始
topArticle.summary: WIPOとWTOが2027年2月1日から12日までジュネーブで開催される、知的財産問題に関する政府高官向け研修プログラムの応募受付を開始した。
